text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I hit a 404 on the handbook runtime page: /handbook/runtime/onboarding.md -> image link https://cdn.redwood.ai/handbook/runtime/diagram.png returns 403. Anyone owning that page?

raj: I can grab it if nobody else claims. Which diagram is it? small flow diagram under 'persistent KV cache'

devon: Thanks @raj. If you can rehost to assets-cdn and update path, runbook will be green. Small PR ok. Also update frontmatter owner: runtime-team.

sre-bot: link-checker: New issue detected: 1x 403 at /handbook/runtime/onboarding.md — ticket DOCS-432 created.

raj: I'll open a PR now. planning to rehost to /assets/handbook/runtime/diagram-v2.png and fix anchor that was pointing to `#kv-cache` -> `#kv-cache-behavior`

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1256 — includes image rehost + anchor fix + frontmatter owner add. sed I used locally:

```bash
git checkout -b fix/runtime-diagram
sed -i 's|https://cdn.redwood.ai/handbook/runtime/diagram.png|/assets/handbook/runtime/diagram-v2.png|g' handbook/runtime/onboarding.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs(runtime): rehost diagram + owner"
```

devon: :thumbsup: I'll review in a bit. tagging @max for perf/infra implications re CDN path.

max: @devon @raj quick note — if we switch paths, add CDN redirect or update static manifest, otherwise we lose old backlinks. If infra can't do redirect quickly, add an explicit note in the PR description so search indexers won't break. Also please add `x-robots-tag: noindex`? maybe not needed.

raj: added change log and PR description. Created follow-up INFRA ticket INFRA-789 for CDN redirect.

elaine: awesome. small ask — can reviewers do a fast CR today? this blocks onboarding sprint task.

devon: I can merge after one LGTM and CI passes. aiming for EOD.

max: I'll ack infra ticket and prioritize if we see significant hits.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: docs site deploy queued for PR 1256 — preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1256

raj: preview looks good. thanks all.

elaine: thanks! closing the loop here. :raised_hands:
